title: UI风格#207 - Coastal Minimal (海岸极简)
description: 创建第207种UI风格：海岸极简风格 - 海洋氛围、沙色海绿、清新极简。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGY.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Coastal Minimal style When color palette Then features seafoam, sand, white, driftwood
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#87CEEB (海蓝), #F5F5DC (沙色), #FFFFFF (白), #DEB887 (漂流木), #20B2AA (海绿)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Coastal Minimal style When typography Then uses breezy sans: Montserrat, Lato, Nunito
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Montserrat (现代), Lato (清晰), Nunito (柔和)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Coastal Minimal style When layout Then open airy spaces, wave patterns, natural textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：开阔空间、海浪图案、自然纹理

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Coastal Minimal style When UI elements Then wave motion, salt texture, sea breeze feel
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：海浪运动、盐纹理、海风感觉

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Coastal Minimal UI When functional Then includes tide chat, wave agents, shore stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：潮汐聊天、海浪代理、岸边统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Coastal Minimal UI When copy Then uses coastal: 'Tide', 'Wave', 'Shore', 'Drift'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'TIDE. WAVE. SHORE.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'DRIFT'、'DEPLOY'→'SURGE'
